label: Raspberry Pi Pico
instructions: Hold BOOTSEL (BOOT on RP2040-Zero) while plugging in USB. Choose the RPI-RP2 or RP2350 boot drive, not a normal folder. The board restarts after the copy. The chip can be checked; Wi-Fi and board variants cannot be auto-detected.

label: Nucleo F401RE
instructions: UART ROM bootloader: use a 3.3 V USB–UART adapter, common GND, adapter TX → PA10 (USART1 RX), adapter RX → PA9 (USART1 TX). Never use 5 V or RS-232 levels. Select system-memory boot via BOOT0/boot option configuration, then reset (see AN2606 for your exact MCU). The normal ST-LINK console port is NOT automatically a ROM bootloader port. After flashing, restore normal boot and reset. For easiest USB installation, download the binary and copy it to the Nucleo ST-LINK drive instead.
